categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the pharmaceutical manufacturing industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of anti-infective drugs, cardiovascular drugs, and digestive system drugs. Its main products include clarithromycin raw materials and preparations, azithromycin dispersible tablets, roxithromycin capsules, lacidipine dispersible tablets, and simvastatin tablets. The company also engages in the production of pharmaceutical intermediates and has a subsidiary involved in new energy technology, which was deregistered in 2024.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing technologies adhering to GMP standards, with core technologies in anti-infective and antihypertensive drug production. It has developed proprietary processes for clarithromycin raw materials and formulations, with multiple patents granted. Production follows a sales-driven procurement and manufacturing model, ensuring quality control throughout the process, including raw material inspection, in-process quality checks, and final product testing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are pharmaceutical manufacturers and distributors both domestically and internationally, including markets in India, South Korea, Japan, Pakistan, and Turkey. It serves hospitals, pharmacies, and private clinics through direct sales, bidding, and agency models. The products are included in national medical insurance and essential drug catalogs, ensuring stable demand in the healthcare sector.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with its headquarters in Shaoxing, Zhejiang Province. It has significant export activities targeting countries such as India, South Korea, Japan, Pakistan, and Turkey. Domestic sales cover multiple provinces and regions, participating actively in national and provincial centralized drug procurement programs.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates both upstream and midstream in the pharmaceutical supply chain, producing active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and finished drug formulations. It integrates pharmaceutical intermediates, raw materials, and finished drug production, enabling control over the entire production process from raw materials to final products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on pharmaceutical innovation, quality enhancement, and expanding its product portfolio in anti-infective and cardiovascular drugs. It invests significantly in R&D, with ongoing projects for new drug development and generic drug consistency evaluations. The company aims to leverage its integrated supply chain to improve production efficiency and market competitiveness while expanding international registrations and certifications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of pharmaceutical raw materials and finished drug products. Sales channels include direct sales to manufacturers and distributors, exports via foreign trade companies, bidding in centralized procurement platforms, and agency sales to pharmacies and clinics. The company also receives government subsidies and investment income, contributing to non-operating revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a competitive player in the pharmaceutical manufacturing sector with a focus on anti-infective and cardiovascular drugs. It holds a leading position in clarithromycin raw material production domestically and competes with other pharmaceutical manufacturers in China and internationally. The company emphasizes product quality, regulatory compliance, and innovation to maintain and grow its market share amid intense industry competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 330 million, a slight decrease of 2.38% from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 7.8 million, down 64.01%. The company maintains total assets near RMB 1 billion and equity of RMB 686 million. Despite some profit decline, cash flow from operations improved significantly. The company continues to invest in R&D and infrastructure, indicating a focus on sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through a fully integrated pharmaceutical supply chain from intermediates to finished products, ensuring quality and cost control. It emphasizes product quality with GMP compliance, patented technologies, and inclusion in national essential drug and medical insurance catalogs. The company also pioneers patient-friendly packaging innovations, such as braille on drug labels and elderly-friendly instructions, demonstrating commitment to social responsibility and customer-centric values.
